controller: B0 only (fixed-time plans, no traffic-responsive behavior)
demand_levels: gen.CALIBRATED (already fixed by the Pilot V2 scenario calibration)
method: EMPIRICAL_FIXED_TIME (predeclared grid search; Webster is NOT claimed)

objective.aggregate: J_plan = mean over the 4 scenarios of the mean over seeds of J_run
objective.per_run: J_run = 1 - 0.40*dC + 0.35*dQ + 0.25*dL ; dC=(c-c_ref)/c_ref, dQ=(q-q_ref)/q_ref, dL=(l-l_ref)/l_ref ; c=completion_ratio_offered, q=mean_network_queue_vehicles, l=mean_time_loss ; *_ref = same scenario and seed under the historical static plan
objective.selection: minimum J_plan among candidates that pass every guard in every scenario
objective.tie_break: candidates with J within 0.005 of the minimum: higher mean completion_ratio_offered, then shorter cycle, then plan_id
objective.validation: selected plan vs reference on untouched validation seeds: J <= 1.0 and all guards pass
